name: designobo
description: Design and edit UI prototypes in Designobo. Browse your team's projects, read and search screens, create new screens, edit existing ones, and check them in a real browser.

interface.longDescription:
Designobo is an AI design tool for building UI prototypes as real HTML screens.

Browse your team's projects, read and search screens, and create new projects and screens. Edit existing screens with your agent and watch the changes appear live in Designobo.

Render screens in a real browser to check for layout and runtime errors, or turn existing designs into code in your own projects.

Your agent only accesses the team you approve when you connect. You can disconnect it at any time from Designobo.
defaultPrompt: Create a Designobo project for a habit tracker app and design its onboarding screens.
Add a pricing section to the home screen of my Designobo project.
Read my Designobo checkout screen and build it as components in this repo.

positive.prompt: What projects do I have in Designobo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's projects, including Brew & Co. Coffee, Pulse Fitness App and Ledger Dashboard, with links.

positive.prompt: Describe the menu screen in my Brew & Co. Coffee project in Designobo.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds menu.html in the Brew & Co. Coffee project and summarizes its categories and prices from the screen's HTML.

positive.prompt: Which screens in my Ledger Dashboard project in Designobo mention invoices?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching screens, such as invoices.html and overview.html, with the lines that mention invoices.

positive.prompt: In my Brew & Co. Coffee project in Designobo, add a seasonal specials section to the home screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a seasonal specials section to home.html in the existing visual style, saves it, and confirms the screen renders without errors.

positive.description: Create a project with a new screen
positive.prompt: Create a Designobo project called Bookshelf and design a book detail screen for it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Bookshelf project, adds a book detail screen, checks that it renders, and shares the project link.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?
